hero.subtitle: Italian Cuisine · Nuremberg
hero.description: Authentic ingredients, traditional recipes, Italian passion — all in a historic venue from 1705, where every dinner becomes an unforgettable memory.

story.label: Our Story
story.p1: In the 19th century, the Lutzgarten — built in 1705 — was a beloved gathering place just outside Nuremberg's gates. Today, we bring the warmth and authentic flavors of Italy to this historic venue.
story.p2: Every dish tells a story: ingredients sourced directly from Italy, recipes passed down through generations, and the passion of two brothers who set out to bring true Italian cuisine to Bavaria.

featured.title: House Favorites
featured.subtitle: Selected by our chef with fresh ingredients imported from Italy

biergarten.label: Outdoors
biergarten.description: Under centuries-old trees, enjoy the summer with a glass of Italian wine and the aromas of our kitchen. A little corner of paradise in the heart of Nuremberg.
